scenes.label: U10 · Glossary
scenes.definition: Software that plans a series of steps toward a goal, uses tools to carry them out, and checks its own work before handing back.
scenes.example: The intake agent gathered the forms, filled the gaps and booked the inspection.
scenes.narration: An agent is software that plans steps toward a goal, uses tools, and checks its own work. For example, an intake agent can book your inspection.

scenes.label: U11
scenes.myth: AI agents send your health records to servers outside Canada.
scenes.fact: Protected health data stays in Canadian data centres, and every access is logged.
scenes.narration: You may have heard that agents send your health records abroad. That is a myth. In fact, protected data stays in Canada.

scenes.label: U15 · Demo
scenes.narration: A resident asks to book a road test. The agent finds a slot in Red Deer, confirms the licence class, and books it.

messages.text: Can I book my class 5 road test for next week?
Yes. The first opening near you is Tuesday at 10:30 in Red Deer. Shall I book it?
Booked. Your confirmation is RT-4821, and a reminder will reach your phone the day before.

scenes.headline: Asking about a benefit
scenes.narration: Six messages: a longer conversation scrolls as it grows, and the agent always shows where its answer comes from and who to call.

messages.text: My hours were cut. Can I get help with rent?
You may qualify for the rent assistance benefit. I need your household size and monthly income.
Based on the published criteria you likely qualify for about 310 dollars a month. A caseworker confirms every application.
I can start the form now with what you've told me, or you can call 310-0000 to speak with someone.

scenes.title: Time and process
scenes.subtitle: Timelines, roadmaps, steps, loops and journeys.

scenes.label: T1 · Digital ID
scenes.headline: Six years of digital ID
scenes.narration: It started in 2019 with a simple login. In 2021 we added identity checks. By 2023 a million Albertans had signed up. In 2025 came the mobile wallet. Today agents can act for you, and next year every ministry joins.

scenes.label: T2 · Roadmap
scenes.headline: What ships when
scenes.narration: Three teams share one roadmap. Field teams get offline maps this spring and drone feeds by summer. Analytics adds spread models and a risk index. The public app gets alerts first, then evacuation routes.

scenes.label: T5 · Grants

scenes.narration: We received twelve thousand applications. Nine thousand were complete, five thousand were reviewed, and two thousand one hundred were approved.

scenes.label: T6 · Journey
scenes.headline: One renewal, five moments
scenes.narration: The reminder email is welcome. People sign in with no trouble. The photo upload is where people get stuck. Payment is quick, and the card arrives in a week.

scenes.label: T7 · Agent
scenes.headline: How the agent books your road test
scenes.narration: The goal is a road test next week. The agent plans, then acts with its tools. It checks the result. The slot was taken, so it plans again. A clerk approves, and you are booked.
scenes.goal: Road test in Red Deer next week
scenes.plan: Find open slots near the applicant
scenes.act: Query the scheduler, hold a slot
scenes.check: Slot still free? Licence class right?
